notes: ROUTE: robots.txt was checked first - it names no AI/Claude agent and does NOT disallow /on/demandware.store/ (its only relevant rules are the prefv/prefn/dwcont/srule filter params, */search/*, and a blanket Disallow for User-agent: python-requests/2.24.0). All SEO HTML on www.athome.com is still behind an Akamai bot challenge, so as in the prior Home-Decor pass I used the storefront's own Salesforce Commerce Cloud controllers on Sites-athome-sfra-Site, which are served unchallenged: Search-Refinebar?cgid=<slug> for the tree plus the count, and Search-UpdateGrid?cgid=<slug>&start=&sz= for enumeration. No proxy was used; every link is the canonical origin URL and all 34 leaf URLs were confirmed present in https://www.athome.com/sitemap_2.xml. TREE: taken from the SFCC catalogue itself - the Refinebar left-nav renders the full department tree (20 top-level departments, their children, and the current node's own children). I walked Furniture and Outdoor > Patio Furniture to their deepest nodes; every leaf was re-queried to confirm it has no further children (the is-current element carries class 'no-subcat' when it is a leaf). Cross-checked against sitemap_2.xml (1237 URLs, grepped for 30+ furniture slug stems) and against llms.txt. QTY: every number is the site's own rendered filter-bar header 'Show N Items' for that exact cgid. Independently corroborated by enumerating Search-UpdateGrid to exhaustion and counting unique data-pid values: 38 of 39 categories matched the header EXACTLY; the single miss was Accent Tables (header 137, enumeration 132), the same ~1%-low page-boundary artefact recorded in the prior pass, so the rendered header was taken and that row is flagged. Method validity check: a fabricated cgid returns HTTP 410 with no header while a real-but-empty category returns HTTP 200 with 'Show 0 Items', so the three 0 rows are genuine empties and not lookup failures. Counts vary widely per category (0 to 750), so no site-wide constant is being read, and no number is round/capped. EXCLUDED per scope: Mattresses & Foundations (6, bedding not furniture); Dining Chair Cushions & Pads and Patio Furniture Covers (cushions/covers); Office Organization and the entire Storage department (Baskets & Bins, Closet Organization including Shoe Storage 27 and Garment Racks 9, Bathroom Organization including Bathroom Shelves/Carts/Storage 14, Laundry, Kitchen Organization, Garage Storage, Trash Cans) - I opened the tiles and they are racks, bins and organisers, i.e. the future Storage task; Step Stools & Ladders (23, utility ladders); Pet Beds (48); Floor Pillows & Poufs (15, filed by the site under Pillows rather than furniture); Patio Umbrellas; Pots & Planters; Lawn & Garden; Outdoor Entertaining; Outdoor Decor / Rugs / Lighting; and the Rugs, Pillows, Bed & Bath, Window, Kitchen & Dining, Wall Art & Mirrors, Decor and Lighting departments. DROPPED as navigation junk: Shop All Furniture, Shop All <room> Furniture, Shop All Patio Furniture, New Products, Furniture Collections, Outdoor Collections and the five named patio collections (Highland, Paloma, Haven, Parkview, Monaco), the seven named furniture collections listed under Furniture Sets (Ellis, Gianna, Amira, Annalise, Marlowe, Mila, Serafina), Furniture Lookbook, 'Free Delivery Patio Sets' (promo), and the three Furniture mega-menu tiles (bar-stools-tile, sofa-tile, college-dorm-furniture-tile) which all return 0 items. Sling Furniture (13) and Wicker Patio Furniture (12) were dropped as material filter views - product-ID intersection shows Sling is a strict subset of Patio Chairs & Seating and Wicker overlaps it by 10 of 12. The Rooms pages (Living Room, Dining Room, Bathroom, Kitchen) all return 0 items. DEDUPLICATED by product-ID intersection: Dorm Furniture (51) dropped - all 51 product IDs are already inside the main Furniture leaves; Work From Home Essentials (27) dropped - all 27 already inside; Living Room > 'Accent Chairs' (/occasional-chairs-recliners/, 41) dropped - it has an identical node name to, and is a strict subset of, Accent Furniture > Accent Chairs (53). The remaining subset relationships were kept because the node names differ, and each one is flagged on its own row. UNASSIGNED-PARENT NOTE: Barstools (49) is emitted as a grouping row per the deepest-URL rule, but its two children Bar Height (21) and Adjustable (23) are disjoint and together cover only 44 of the 49 - 5 barstools sit on the parent only. Likewise Patio Chairs & Seating (39) is a grouping row whose six children cover only 25 of the 39. ABSENCE CHECKS: no bathroom vanity or vanity-unit furniture exists on this site (sitemap grep for vanity/vanities plus a walk of the Bathroom Organization tree found only counter organisers and shelves); no kids or nursery furniture either - /kids-furniture/ returns 0 items, and Kids' Decor (3) and Kids' Storage (16) are decor and bins.
